title: Equations in the Form y = mx Review Test
description: Write and interpret proportional linear equations in the form y = mx.

questions.questionText: A line goes through the origin and the point (1, 2/3). Which equation has the form y = mx for this line?
questions.explanation: For a line through the origin, m is the constant of proportionality and y = mx.
